title: Team meeting
description: Participate in a team meeting, share your opinion, and discuss a deadline.
descriptionIt: Partecipa a una riunione, condividi la tua opinione e discuti una scadenza.
setting: A weekly team meeting at your office. The manager opens the floor for discussion.
aiCharacter: Supportive manager named Sarah. Encourages everyone to share their views.
goals: Share your opinion on a work topic
openingLine: Good morning, everyone. Today I'd like to hear your thoughts on flexible working hours. What do you think?
